corrupt_state.expected_behavior: startup verification detects the broken signature and the release refuses to serve rather than starting over corrupt state; once the record is repaired the same state directory boots and is ready
corrupt_state.injection: one committed signed audit record is edited in place while the host is stopped, then the release is restarted against that state
corrupt_state.observed_behavior: the release refused to start: configuration error: existing audit chains failed signature verification; after repair /v1/ready returned 200

full_disks.expected_behavior: the turn fails with a stable bounded error instead of a partial write, previously committed sessions, sandboxes and audit chains are untouched, and the host serves again once space is reclaimed
full_disks.injection: the state filesystem is filled to ENOSPC before a turn (62914560 bytes of ballast until errno 28)
full_disks.observed_behavior: the turn under ENOSPC returned 500; /v1/ready returned 500; the turn after reclaiming space returned 200

interrupted_writes.expected_behavior: after the documented lease-expiry wait, the atomic replace discipline leaves every previously committed file intact, no torn temporary file is adopted on restart, and the release becomes ready and accepts new turns
interrupted_writes.injection: a Linux LD_PRELOAD rename observer stops the host after its session temporary file is closed but before replacement; the harness verifies the stopped PID and temporary bytes, then SIGKILLs its process group
interrupted_writes.observed_behavior: the interrupted turn ended as "RemoteDisconnected('Remote end closed connection without response')"; after restart /v1/ready returned 200 and a new turn returned 200; uncommitted session adopted: False; ignored temporary files retained: ['3b9679c3ef383c241dc934ecdddafd9e81737200d3a3effb6dd1c4e3de132885.kv.tmp']

network_failures.expected_behavior: the turn fails with a stable gateway error within its deadline, without disclosing transport diagnostics; readiness is unaffected and the next turn succeeds
network_failures.injection: the completion endpoint accepts the connection and closes it without a response, so the call fails at the transport rather than with a status
network_failures.observed_behavior: the turn returned 502 'agent_failure'; /v1/ready returned 200; the turn after the fault cleared returned 200

runtime_crashes.expected_behavior: the detecting call fails with stable 502 agent_failure, retiring the compiler without replaying uncertain side effects; a separate next call obtains a replacement, succeeds, and readiness passes
runtime_crashes.injection: SIGKILL every forge child of the running host, mid-service
runtime_crashes.observed_behavior: killed forge children [2401]; the detecting call returned 502; a separate recovery turn returned 200 and /v1/ready returned 200

unavailable_model_providers.expected_behavior: the turn fails with the stable 502 agent_failure carrying no provider diagnostics, readiness stays up because the dependency is external, and the next turn succeeds once the provider returns
unavailable_model_providers.injection: the configured completion endpoint answers every request with 503 overloaded_error for the duration of one turn
unavailable_model_providers.observed_behavior: the turn returned 502 'agent_failure'; /v1/ready returned 200; the turn after recovery returned 200
